scope: Native C bug-fix adoption, reproducible execution/measurement, baseline statistics and failure analysis; no new gameplay strategies

integration_policy.authority: Owner instruction 2026-11-06: merge, measure impact and keep going
integration_policy.per_pr: Agent evidence review, normal PR merge and required green checks
integration_policy.external_review: At an accumulated change/evidence milestone; not a per-PR prerequisite

priority_policy: Bugs first, carried or not; verified carries/concrete defect investigations pre-empt discretionary death-analysis work
original_c_discovery_flow: Evidence/duplicate/ownership check -> neo-angband-tracker issue and source fix -> separate consumer adoption/measurement
